title: unified-rollouts: staged shadow + canary + A/B auto-rollback enhancements and safety guards
author: Jordan Li
release_notes: Enhances Unified Rollouts with staged probing for shadow traffic, improved canary/A-B weighting controls, and automated multi-metric rollback safety guards. Backwards-compatible config; no breaking changes.
body:
Summary: This PR adds staged shadow probing, refines canary/A-B weighted rollout logic, and implements multi-metric automated rollback safety guards for Unified Rollouts. Motivation: customers running high-throughput inference need safer progressive rollouts that can probe new model variants with low blast radius, compare them in A/B modes, and automatically roll back on multi-dimensional regressions (latency, error-rate, and quality delta). This work is driven by ENG-7285 and field incidents SUP-4503 where shadow-only probing missed latency regressions under production batching patterns.

What changed (high level): - Introduced `staged_shadow` pipeline: allows configurable probing windows where shadow requests are sent progressively (0.1% -> 1% -> 10%) with adaptive backoff when metric noise is detected. - Enhanced canary/A-B weight scheduler: supports staged increments, time-based holds, and fast-safety-abort hooks when configured thresholds are breached. - Multi-metric rollback engine: evaluates latency P95, error-rate (HTTP 5xx and model-level errors), and a quality regression signal (delta on a lightweight prompt set). The engine supports both hard thresholds and composite scoring. - Observability: new rollout metrics (rollout_progress, shadow_reject_rate, composite_regression_score) and tracing tags for staged events. - E2E and stability tests: added integration tests simulating production batching and KV-cache warmup scenarios. - Docs & API: rollout spec extended (`stagedShadow`, `weights`, `rollbackPolicy`) with examples and migration notes.

Commits (summary): - 1a2b3c4: add staged shadow controller and API schema - 2b3c4d5: implement staggered weight scheduler and time-hold logic - 3c4d5e6: multi-metric rollback engine and composite scoring - 4d5e6f7: wire metrics, tracing, and console dashboards - 5e6f7g8: integration tests for batching/kvcache failure modes - 6f7g8h9: docs, examples, and migration guide

Files changed (representative): - rollout/controller/staged_shadow_controller.go - rollout/scheduler/weight_scheduler.go - rollout/rollback/multi_metric_engine.go - rollout/specs/v1/rollout_schema.yaml - telemetry/metrics/rollout_metrics.go - tests/integration/rollout_staged_shadow_test.go - docs/rollouts/staged_shadow.md - console/frontend/src/rollouts/rolloutDetail.tsx

Testing & CI: All CI checks passed on final run. Unit tests added for scheduler and rollback engine; integration tests run in the perf-canary job to validate behavior under synthetic batching. Perf canary reported negligible overhead (<1% token latency) for control-paths; staged shadow adds proportional traffic but is opt-in per rollout.

Review timeline and comments: - Priya: requested clearer failure modes and a kill-switch. Author added `stagedShadow.disable` flag and wired a global emergency-stop that immediately halts shadow traffic. - Evan: asked for observability hooks; author added rollout_progress and tracing tags. - Sofia: requested canary weight hold semantics; author implemented time-based holds and added unit tests. Several subsequent approvals after addressing comments.

Rollout plan: - Feature gated behind `rollouts.stagedShadow.enabled` - Default off for existing customers; opt-in via rollout spec. - Start internal dogfood on dedicated infra for 2 weeks with synthetic traffic, then open to selected customers behind feature flag. - Monitor composite_regression_score and latency P95; automated rollback will trigger on configured thresholds.

Backward compatibility & migration: Schema extends the rollout spec with optional fields (`stagedShadow`, `rollbackPolicy.v2`) and defaults to previous behavior when absent. No model-serving API changes.

Known limitations & follow-ups: - Quality delta currently uses a lightweight prompt set (fast but noisy); follow-up work will integrate full evals and drift detection (ENG-7420). - Staged probing currently uses global percent buckets; upcoming work will add per-route sampling weights.

Related tickets: ENG-7285, PM-312, SUP-4503.

Merge notes: Squash-merged after approvals from reviewers and green CI. Observability dashboards were deployed alongside the rollout controller to enable monitoring during the staged rollout.
